behavior: Home prices round to the nearest $1,000 and have a $1,000 minimum; the game retains this legacy purchase calibration.
A new hire starts at the 25th wage percentile and reaches the 75th over 20 years at the employer; this is a retained game calibration, not a sourced tenure curve.
The legacy job-rate reader applies federal and state minimum wages; local minimum wages are not modeled.
Policy-rate midpoint stands in for 30-year mortgage-rate changes; a measured pass-through is unavailable in the macro records.
Home-price growth has no supply-response term until a place-level housing-supply elasticity is measured.
Before the first recorded macro month, home-price levels are assumed to have grown with income and sit at the usual price-to-income ratio.
The legacy estimated eviction disposition uses a four-month counsel threshold and two-month lenient-judge threshold; both remain estimates until supported by broader records.
